tokens.name: vv-page
tokens.usage: Page ground on the site (bg-vv-page). Everything sits on this.

tokens.name: vv-band
tokens.usage: Alternate full-width bands: How it works, Proof, What you get (bg-vv-band).

tokens.name: vv-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an app screen (bg-vv-bg); also the dark text on light buttons.

tokens.name: vv-camera
tokens.usage: The camera screen's background.

tokens.name: vv-phone
tokens.usage: The phone bezel around app screens on the site.

tokens.name: vv-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, inputs, app list groups (bg-vv-surface).

tokens.name: vv-surface2
tokens.usage: Chips at rest, the chat composer, rows inside app cards (bg-vv-surface2).

tokens.name: vv-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons; also the fill of light (inverse) buttons. 15.7:1 on vv-surface.

tokens.name: vv-text2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: intros, descriptions, nav links. 8.9:1 on vv-surface.

tokens.name: vv-text3
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, notes under forms, placeholders. 6.4:1 on vv-surface; never body copy.

tokens.name: vv-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, step numbers, check icons, highlighted words, hover text. 10:1 on vv-surface.

tokens.name: vv-stroke
tokens.usage: Focus borders on inputs, the selected chip, camera brackets, the pick card's outline (at 45%).

tokens.name: vv-warning
tokens.usage: Something needs the person's attention, such as a misread vintage.

tokens.name: vv-error
tokens.usage: Form error messages (text-[#F9A8D4] in code).

tokens.name: vv-primary-from
tokens.usage: Start of the primary gradient (bg-vv-primary: #9333EA to #A21CAF, left to right). The only fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: vv-primary-to
tokens.usage: End of the primary gradient.

tokens.name: vv-glow
tokens.usage: The radial glow behind the hero (at 22%), success and selected tints (at 16-18%), the pick card halo (at 8%).
